---
name: Evidence correction
about: A quoted span, figure, role, or claim on the site does not match its source
title: "[correction] <evaluator or entity>: <signal or row id>"
labels: correction
---
## Where
Signal or row id (for example `metr.14` or `T12`), and the page URL.

## What the source says
Quote the exact span from the cited source, or state that the source no longer contains it.

## What the site says
Copy the claim as shown.

## Proposed change
New claim text, new value, or "retract".

## Disclosure
Your relationship, if any, to the evaluator or lab named; or "none".
